ha-automations is a set of [AppDaemon](https://appdaemon.readthedocs.io/) apps for Home Assistant, written in Python and tested before each release. Pick an app, configure it in `apps.yaml`, and deploy.

## Apps

### Lights

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
#### [Sunrise Fade](docs/apps/sunrise-fade.qmd)

Turns a light on dim before dawn and brightens it as the sun rises, then turns it off once it is light out. A gentle wake-up for a bedroom.

```{python}
#| echo: false
h.fade_chart(sunrise_fade.SunriseSettings, height=2.4)
```
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
#### [Sunset Fade](docs/apps/sunset-fade.qmd)

Brightens a light as the sun goes down, so the room never goes dark. Stays on for the evening.

```{python}
#| echo: false
h.fade_chart(sunset_fade.SunsetSettings, height=2.4)
```
:::

:::

Need something else? [Light Fade](docs/apps/light-fade.qmd) is the general fade the two apps are built on. Choose your own levels, triggers and direction.

## Get started

1. Install the AppDaemon and Advanced SSH & Web Terminal add-ons. See [Overview](user-guide/overview.qmd).
2. Create your private config repo from the [template](https://github.com/joshwlivingston/ha-automations-config-template). See [Config repo](user-guide/config-repo.qmd).
3. Add an app to `apps.yaml`:

   ```yaml
   bedroom_sunrise:
     module: sunrise_fade
     class: SunriseFade
     light: light.bedroom_lamp
   ```

4. Push to `main` and the config repo's workflow deploys the latest release. See [Deploy](user-guide/deploy.qmd).
5. Check it loaded and fire a test event. See [Verify](user-guide/verify.qmd).
